dedupe_keys.name: global crop specific nitrogen fertilization dataset 1961 2020

description: This dataset maps nitrogen fertiliser application rates worldwide by crop group, fertiliser type and placement, together with gridded harvested areas, for every year from 1961 to 2020. It harmonises earlier fertiliser datasets that differed in time span, resolution and crop allocation, using statistics such as IFASTAT, cropland from HYDE 3.2 and harvested areas from EARTHSTAT. It was produced by Wulahati Adalibieke, Xiaoqing Cui, Hongwei Cai, Liangzhi You, Feng Zhou and colleagues and described in a data descriptor in Scientific Data. Coverage is global at 5 arc-minutes, about 10 km, in the WGS84 system. The files are HDF5, one per crop group, held at the National Tibetan Plateau / Third Pole Environment Data Center and free to download; the article is CC BY 4.0, while the dataset's own terms were not read. Caveats: rates are estimates built by disaggregating national statistics with assumptions, and the authors note gaps such as missing IFASTAT consumption data for some fertiliser types in 1962 to 1972. For simulation it gives historical nitrogen inputs for crop, water quality and emissions models, supporting climate adaptation studies and assessments of how disruptions to fertiliser supply chains would affect farm output. It is related to the NPKGRIDS record in this catalogue, which adds phosphorus and potassium for 2020.
